description: Election Commission - Declare that A. K. M. A. Kaluarachchi as a Member of the Mahiyangana Pradeshiya Sabha
categorisation: This gazette content specifically deals with filling a vacancy in a local government body (Mahiyangana Pradeshiya Sabha) under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It involves the electoral process, nomination of a candidate, and declaration of election results for a local government position, which falls squarely under the Elections category (Type 7) for electoral processes and related matters.
